newsitem.title: GERMANY: MAN sees higher earnings, profits in 96/97.
newsitem.headline: MAN sees higher earnings, profits in 96/97.

text.p: German truck manufacturer and engineering group MAN AG said it expects a small increase in earnings and sales in the 1996/97 business year that ends June 30.

MAN chairman Klaus Goette said the company was aiming for a return on sales of at least 2.5 percent during the year, adding that improved economic conditions were needed to help it meet its performance goals
The return on sales in the 1995/96 business year was 1.6 percent.
The company had earlier said it expected a continued upward trend in its profits and good earnings for its 1996/97 business year.
